If desired, add a teaspoon of sugar or a splash of milk to taste. Stir the tea gently to mix the additions. Finally, enjoy the tea while it is still warm. This method ensures a clean, safe, and flavorful cup of tea using simple, everyday items.

Discard the used tea bag or dispose of the tea leaves. Wipe the mug and tea infuser clean with a cloth. Turn off the stove if using a kettle on the stove. Ensure all items are cooled and stored properly.
